body.html: TK Residence sits at 419/9 Thung Sri Muang Rd, Tambon Kalasin, Mueang Kalasin District — on the edge of town, about 1 km from the centre but close to the bus station, convenience stores and coffee shops just a few minutes' walk away. It's a small, friendly residence that drivers passing through Kalasin on business or for an overnight pick because it's easy to find, easy to park at, and sits away from the bustle of the centre.

What guests mention most is rooms that feel bigger and cleaner than the price suggests. Many reviews describe airy rooms, comfortable beds, good cold air-con, and showers with stronger water pressure than you'd expect at this budget. Several rooms have a balcony for some fresh air and a quiet town view. Rooms come with air-con, a fridge and Wi-Fi — everything you need for an overnight stay. That's why cleanliness and location both score well here.
"The room was spacious and very clean for the price, comfortable bed, good water pressure, and so quiet I slept well — the staff were lovely and helpful. Great value for an overnight in Kalasin."

The other recurring praise is the quiet and the genuinely helpful staff. Being on the edge of town keeps nights peaceful, and many guests say they slept undisturbed. There's a restaurant and café on site, a simple Asian breakfast, plus car rental, room service and a 24-hour front desk for late arrivals. Free parking is another point self-drivers rate highly.

To be honest — this is a small property with limited extras. Some reviews note staff don't speak much English, a basic breakfast that doesn't suit everyone, water pressure that varies between rooms, and the absence of little touches like an in-room safe or coffee kit. A few guests found a bathroom with no shower curtain. The other thing to plan for is the out-of-centre location — without your own car, getting into town is less convenient than a central hotel.

Bottom line: TK Residence suits self-drivers who want a spacious, clean, quiet room at an easy price for an overnight or a work trip in Kalasin. The overall score of around 8.6 from real reviews reflects exactly that — roomy, clean and peaceful, with helpful staff, but a small place with basic facilities a little outside the centre. Set your expectations to match and lead with value and quiet, and most people sleep just fine for a night.

faq.q: Where is TK Residence in Kalasin?
faq.a: It sits at 419/9 Thung Sri Muang Rd, Tambon Kalasin, Mueang Kalasin District, on the edge of town about 1 km from the centre. The bus station, Wat Pa Thung Sri Muang, convenience stores and cafés are all a few minutes' walk away.

faq.q: What are the starting prices and room types?
faq.a: Rooms start at around ฿500/night for a Standard queen. There's a Standard twin from about ฿550 and a room with a balcony from about ฿620. One guest reported a 3-night package for 2 with breakfast at around ฿1,950 (about ฿650/night). Prices vary by season — always compare a few platforms before booking.

The highlight is rooms that feel bigger and cleaner than the price, with comfortable beds, cold air-con, strong showers, and balconies on many rooms. But it's a small property with basic facilities — no in-room safe or coffee kit, and some rooms have no shower curtain.

faq.q: Who is this hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for self-drivers who want a spacious, clean, quiet room at an easy price for an overnight or work trip in Kalasin. It's less ideal for travellers without a car or those wanting a central, fully-equipped hotel.
